description: Plan S30 held-out set v1, written 2026-11-28 and committed before any signal or LLM run on it. Synthetic questions labelled by the kind of source that answers them. 'scholarly': research literature or scientific data answers it, so the Evidence service is the right one. 'practical': documentation, a specification, a manual or a how-to guide answers it. 'reference': a general reference page answers it. Each case is asked twice, as 'invocations' says. The dev set is the knowledge-quality fixtures (eval/fixtures/knowledge_quality/); nothing is tuned on this file.

labels.scholarly: research literature or scientific data answers it
labels.practical: documentation, a specification, a manual or a how-to guide answers it
labels.reference: a general reference page answers it

invocations.default: {prompt}, with Evidence as the default knowledge service

cases.prompt: How do I expose a port from a Docker container to the host?
How does Kerberos issue a service ticket to a client?
cases.note: 'How does X work' form; the answer is in the protocol specification and its documentation

cases.prompt: Does pair programming reduce defects compared with solo programming?
How does code review affect software quality?
cases.note: 'How does X' form; answered by empirical software-engineering studies

cases.prompt: What does CORS stand for in web development?
How do I use an asthma inhaler with a spacer?
How should I measure my blood pressure at home?
How does metformin lower blood glucose?
cases.note: 'How does X' mechanism question; answered by research literature

cases.prompt: What is the most effective way to quit smoking?
cases.note: practical wording; answered by cessation trials and reviews

cases.prompt: How do I collimate a Newtonian telescope?
